title: Nusu language
description: Tibeto-Burman language of southwest China and northern Myanmar
extract: The Nusu language is a Loloish language spoken by the Nu people of China and Myanmar. There are three dialects: Northern, Southern, and Central. The Central dialect of Miangu is the prestige dialect and is understood fairly well by speakers of other dialects.
